India wins Youth Hockey5s Asian Championship, teams compete in other events

The Indian men's team won the FIH Youth Hockey5s Asian Championship, defeating Pakistan 3-1 in the final after earlier wins against Pakistan (7-3) and Oman (10-1). The Indian women's team secured a silver medal at the same championship. Separately, the Indian men's squash team reached the semifinals of the World Junior Championships, while the women's team was eliminated. In a different context, the Indian men's hockey team's switch to saffron jerseys for the World Cup drew criticism from a former captain.
